title: backlog.py land waits for the merge request of a code-lane item without --wait-merge, or names the lane before its first push
goal: land of an item whose commits go through the code lane, run without --wait-merge, prints the lane and the --wait-merge SECONDS rerun before its first push, so an orchestrator reads the two-pass landing before the push and does not run every such landing twice by surprise (gate g1: no wait by default)

gates.question: Which way does land stop running every code-lane landing twice: wait for the merge request by default, or print the lane and the --wait-merge rerun before the first push?
options: wait by default: a code-lane land waits for its merge request up to 1800 s unless --wait-merge SECONDS names another bound (0 stops after the first pass)
print the lane and the --wait-merge rerun before the first push, no wait without the flag
gates.recommendation: wait by default: a code-lane land waits for its merge request up to 1800 s unless --wait-merge SECONDS names another bound (0 stops after the first pass)
gates.answer: print the lane and the --wait-merge rerun before the first push, no wait without the flag

notes: Retrospective SP-ceucrhca 2026-10-12: land ST-wkuogen4 without --wait-merge pushed code/ST-wkuogen4 and exited saying to run land again; every later landing of the sprint (BG-axnjcayu, ST-gngo7etc, ST-wtpwtlk4) went through the code lane and was run with --wait-merge. SP-e4fm2ovk close (2026-10-13): it happened twice more: land BG-v5f5tn5y (a _tools fix) and land ST-2zlpwzbs (kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md only) without --wait-merge each pushed code/<id>, stopped as not done, and needed a second land with --wait-merge. Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 13 of 15, "Landing and close: clause credit by carrier, ledger checks by item, the code-lane wait and checks that run behaviour"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates. Premise read in the tree (2026-10-13): cmd_land returns after the first pass when --wait-merge is None, so a code-lane land pushes code/<id> and exits asking for a rerun; the check exits 2 (selector collects no test: the test is the work). Gate g1 is class push, answered with the conservative option: print the lane and the rerun before the push, no wait by default.
